title: Proliferation Transitions for Quantum Doubles of Groups
summary: Proliferation transitions are phase transitions between a 2+1d topological order $\mathcal{T}$ and another $\mathcal{T}/\mathcal{A}$, obtained by condensing anyons in an algebra $\mathcal{A}\subset \mathcal{T}$. We consider such transitions in quantum doubles of groups, $\mathcal{T}=D(G, ω)$, for finite groups $G$ possibly with three-cocycle $ω$, for which condensable algebras are fully classified.
